text:
maria: Quick note 1 Apr EU change window 22:00-23:00 UTC. We're rolling runtime v2.3.0 for hosted. Need statuspage + short email.

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled id=rb-2026-04-21-22 start=2026-04-21T22:00:00Z window=60m canary=eu-west-1.

tom: Will run canary at 5% for 10m then 30% for 20m. Auto-revert if p95 > 500ms for 3m or 5xx > 0.5% for 3m.

support: Draft statuspage snippet: "Planned maintenance: Hosted runtime upgrade to v2.3.0 on 2026-04-21 22:00-23:00 UTC. Small percentage of requests may be routed to canaries and see transient latency differences. No planned downtime."

ops_lead: Rollback checklist (ops channel): trafficctl revert --to=2.2.x; deploy-bot cancel rb-2026-04-21-22; update statuspage to "Rollback in progress"; escalate if errors persist.

maria: Legal asked to avoid numeric promises. Support, soften "transient latency differences" only.

support: Done. Pre-announce queued at 21:30 UTC, full email will go at 22:10 after canary pass. Includes opt-in link for Dedicated customers.

deploy-bot: Canary hold alert configured and will post here on hold.

maria: Preflight scheduled 21:15 UTC. Post results here. If anyone sees issues after 22:00, call on-call and post in #eng-oncall. Thanks.
